messages.author: 4d367efe02bee69e
messages.subject: trouble with rstantools on Windows
parts:
Hi,
I experienced a couple of issues while trying to build a package on Windows:

1. Rstantools creates a skeleton with cleanup.win file that contains call to sed
  sed -i.bak '/current_statement_begin__ = [0-9]/d' src/include/models.hpp
The problem is that on Windows, GNU sed will change permissions (drastically reduce them)  of the edited file, making  models.hpp unreachable
Modules.cpp:3:30: fatal error: include/models.hpp: Permission denied
It is apparently a well known bug of sed, e.g. https://cygwin.com/ml/cygwin/2012-02/msg00616.html

2. In DESCRIPTION file methods have minimum specified as (>= 3.4.0), but there is no such thing on Windows, the latest method is of version 3.3.2. I noticed that in rstanarm's DESCROPTION file there is no minimum.

Regards,
Slawek
